deploy.on_merge: Nothing deploys on merge or push. artbitrage.io is the Cloudflare Pages project artbitrage, deployed by hand: git fetch and rebase, node tools/build-dist.mjs, the test suite, node tools/live-compare.mjs --ref origin/main, then wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=artbitrage --branch=main (README, Publish)
deploy.after_deploy: node tools/live-compare.mjs: live should equal this dist/ (README, Publish). The repository sets no cache headers for the icons or cards
deploy.rules: not recorded in the repository: /README.md's Publish steps are the procedure, and no file says whose word a release needs. Under the shared ground a deploy is an outward act that needs Yu's or the owner's word

notes: The kit's outputs are git-ignored (kit/.gitignore: out/). recipe.sh writes them to kit/out/, and the committed copies are the installed ones at the repository root, so serve.from names the root and the check holds the dist/ mirror (what deploys) to it byte for byte. Nothing compares the root with kit/out/, which a clean checkout doesn't have.

recipe.sh refuses to run unless vectorcraft-cli is exactly 0.7.0 and photocraft-cli 0.5.0. Neither is installed on any known machine (review 2026-11-02 §2.2; on 2026-11-05 the Studio has 0.17.0 and 0.16.0). This is a hand-made kit: never rebuild it with other versions or overwrite it with a generated kit (review §8).
tools/craft/render.py runs its pinned CLIs from ~/craft-apps/<app>-v<version>/… (or VECTORCRAFT_CLI, PHOTOCRAFT_CLI and DESIGNCRAFT_CLI), not from PATH, and records each release's zip sha256.

/manifest.json is the site's philosophy document, not a web-app manifest. The icon uses /site.webmanifest; never create or overwrite manifest.json (the recipe refuses to run if one sits in its output folder).

The icon's head block lives in head.py (ICON_LINKS), which the page generators import, so site.snippet names it; the hand-written pages carry the same lines. theme-color isn't part of the shared block: each room keeps its own, pinned by tests/e2e-brand.mjs, and site.html carries those per page. The web manifest's #17271f and the home page's #121018 disagree (review 2026-11-02, A1).
/still-we-meet carries neither the icon block nor share tags: its own test holds it to zero <link> tags. /nen keeps its own 念 icon. Neither is listed under site.html.
tests/e2e-brand.mjs runs by hand, in the README's verify list. No CI runs it: the repository has no test script, and its two workflows only ping the live API on a schedule.
The README names a GitHub Pages mirror at cambridgetcg.github.io/artbitrage/, but the repository has no Pages site (the API answered 404) and /artbitrage/favicon.svg there answered 404 on 2026-11-05.
The icon kit itself sets no type, so build.fonts is empty.
